DIAGNOSIS READY: Cholangiocarcinoma (likely distal or pancreatic head origin).

The history of painless jaundice, pruritus, pale stools, dark urine, and significant weight loss in a 72-year-old male is classic for malignant obstruction of the biliary tree.
